Tickets purchased from unauthorised sources may be rendered invalid and admission refused. Tickets must be valid, presented in full according to the authorised agents delivery methods and not altered or tampered with.

Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. Tickets purchased from unauthorised sources may be rendered invalid and admission refused. Tickets must be valid, presented in full according to the authorised agents delivery methods and not altered or tampered with.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. The Event is not suitable for young children. Children under 13 (Aged 12 or below) are NOT permitted. All under 16s must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder aged 18 or over who must remain on site throughout the Event as the under 16-year-old's guardian. No unaccompanied under 16s are allowed on site Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. description:
England vs Norway quarter final, live on the big screen with a free after party.

We’re showing the game in full, with doors open ahead of kick-off. Plus an after party (house, disco and party music til the small hours).

Lively crowd, full venue sound and a proper match atmosphere from start to the post game champagne.

Kick-off is 10pm, doors open 9:30pm. After party doors just after the match ends.

----

Please note:
- Standing tickets only.
- Some people may find their view restricted.
- First come first serve on entry for both parts of the night. Arrive early to avoid disappointment.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.

Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.

Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

Generations is a Sunday afternoon dedicated to bringing families together presented by DJ Curtis Whyte, Gemma Knight Jones and Daniel James. 

Inspired by the days when everyone would gather at Gran’s house for good food, great conversation and plenty of laughter, Generations creates a space where grandparents, parents, aunties, uncles, cousins and children can reconnect and make new memories.



Enjoy a delicious meal, live entertainment and family-friendly music spanning the decades, from Motown and Soul classics through to R&B, Reggae, Soca and today’s favourites.



In a world where quality time can be hard to find, Generations is a chance to slow down, share a table and celebrate the people who matter most.






The Soul Mama Menu offers a delightful blend of African, Caribbean, and South American cuisine. Soul Mama was listed in the “top restaurants to look forward to in 2024 list” by the Evening Standard. Please take a moment to explore our menu.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

Brunch from 12:00pm | Last Reservation 3:00pm | Music 12:30-3:30pm

Sunday takes on a slower, more soulful rhythm with Sunday Soul Sessions, where carefully selected DJ sets shape the soundtrack to a relaxed afternoon in the Hine Bar and Garden Terrace. Each week, a rotating line-up of DJs brings their own blend of classic soul, mellow rarities and warm, groove-led selections.

The music unfolds gradually from early afternoon, creating an easy, unhurried atmosphere that moves between laid-back listening and gentle energy as the room fills. It’s a setting designed for lingering, where the soundtrack complements the pace of a long Sunday rather than competing with it.

Guests can enjoy a two-course brunch with a complimentary Boisdale Bellini for £39.50, featuring Boisdale favourites from eggs Benedict to traditional Sunday roasts. For those looking to extend the occasion, 90 minutes of free-flowing red, white or sparkling wine is available for £25 per person.

With doors from 12pm and music from 12:30pm, the experience flows between the elegant interior and the garden terrace overlooking Cabot Square, offering a refined yet relaxed way to spend a Sunday afternoon.

Hine Bar & Garden Terrace:
Nestled in Cabot Square, overlooking the fountain with a stunning cityscape in the distance, the Hine Bar & Heated Garden Terrace at Boisdale of Canary Wharf is the ultimate spot for any occasion. From fine wines and premium spirits to expertly crafted cocktails including eight signature Hine cocktails- the selection is second to none.

As home to the world’s most extensive collection of Hine Vintage Cognacs, dating back to 1914, the bar is a destination in itself. Pair your drink of choice with an array of Scottish cuisine, fresh seafood, steaks, burgers, pizzas and more alongside our exclusive weekend brunch menus.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Apps Court, Surrey - Sunday 12th July 2026
Surrey is about to feel the pulse of indie music like never before. Electric Heart Festival makes its debut at Apps Court, offering a full day of legendary British indie sounds, live performances, and festival magic.
The inaugural lineup celebrates the best of the genre, featuring Supergrass, Happy Mondays, The Coral & Sleeper. From timeless anthems to euphoric choruses, Electric Heart promises an atmosphere that will hit every fan right in the chest.
LINE UP:
·SupergrassHigh-energy Britpop hits that defined a generation, including Alright and Pumping on Your Stereo.
· Happy MondaysMadchester icons bringing groove-laden festival classics like Step On and Kinky Afro.
· The CoralPsychedelic indie melodies with fan favourites such as Dreaming of You and In The Morning.
· Sleeper90s indie favourites including Inbetweener and Vegas, adding pure nostalgia vibes.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

description:
In the fall of 2025, DARKSIDE held a six-show residency at Lodge Room in Los Angeles. The trio of Dave Harrington, Nicolas Jaar and Tlacael Esparza had so much fun that they decided to do it all over again and then some. The band will now bring this same residency format to three new cities as part of their 2026 touring schedule, with a return to Lodge Room (eight shows across four nights this time), plus similar intimate runs in Paris, London, and New York City. The 2025 Los Angeles shows saw the band stretching out and improvising deeply, drawing from their entire catalog and collaborating with new musicians, a creative approach they are excited to explore further this year.

description:
I Am The Avalanche 

Twenty-two years into their career, I Am The Avalanche are making the most powerful music oftheir lives.

With their fifth studio album, ‘The Horror Show’, the Brooklyn punk rockcornerstones deliver a record forged in grief, courage, and the refusal to stand still. Writtenlargely in the wake of frontman Vinnie Caruana’s profound personal loss, the album exploresfriendship, mortality, love, and resilience with a deeper emotional weight than ever before, whileembracing total creative freedom.

Produced, engineered, and mixed by drummer Brett Romnesat Barbershop Studios in New Jersey, ‘The Horror Show’ is the band’s most expansive andtextural release yet — a record that holds grief and celebration side by side.

Set for release on April 10th, 2026, it finds I Am The Avalanche not merely surviving, but thriving at the peak oftheir powers.

description:
The street sounds of the Colombia’s Caribbean meets merengue, champeta, punk, and hip-hop with precise percussion and inventive vocals.

Formed in 2014, the trio quickly made their mark, winning Best Emerging Group at Sucre’s Festival de Gaitas de Ovejas in 2015.

Over the past decade, they’ve toured the globe, collaborating with the likes of Frente Cumbiero,La Dame Blanche, and Nubya Garcia along the way.

On stage, La Perla are compelling and immersive: intricate vocal lines, ancestral drums, and an energy that honours tradition whilst pushing it forward.

Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. 

CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. This event is strictly 18+ with ID required on arrival at the venue.

description:
The Comedy Store Players have been wowing audiences for many years with their improvisational skills, creating unique shows every Sunday in the heart of London’s West End. The concept is simple – the team will ask the audience for suggestions of locations, genres and characters, then improvise hilarious scenes and sketches around those ideas. 
No two performances are ever the same and the only limit is your imagination!

The regular Players are Josie Lawrence, Richard Vranch, Neil Mullarkey, Lee Simpson and Ruth Bratt. They also draw from a pool of superb guests including Stephen Frost, Mike McShane, Marcus Brigstocke, Sophie Duker, Rachel Parris, Steve Steen, Ian Coppinger, Steve Edis, Pippa Evans, Niall Ashdown, Phelim McDermott, Cariad Lloyd, Phill Jupitus, Kirsty Newton, David Reed.

Running time: 2 hours (approx)

Strictly 18’s and over

BAR & DINER OPEN FROM 6.30PM

description:
Five Women. One Sound. No apologies. A concert-theatre experience for everyone who has ever needed a night that was entirely, unapologetically theirs.

Sirens: The Concert Series is a high-voltage live concert experience featuring five fearless women and twenty of the most iconic songs ever written, from artists including Evanescence, Destiny's Child, Guns N' Roses, Kelly Clarkson, Dua Lipa, Alanis Morissette, Carrie Underwood, Bruno Mars, Lady Gaga, Billie Eilish, Michael Jackson, Christina Aguilera, Pussycat Dolls, Queen, Madonna and Sia.

Launching at Emerald Theatre London on 1st July 2026, each song is brought to life through the lens of a character you will recognise, a story you will feel, and a moment you will carry home.

description:
In the fall of 2025, DARKSIDE held a six-show residency at Lodge Room in Los Angeles. The trio of Dave Harrington, Nicolas Jaar and Tlacael Esparza had so much fun that they decided to do it all over again and then some. The band will now bring this same residency format to three new cities as part of their 2026 touring schedule, with a return to Lodge Room (eight shows across four nights this time), plus similar intimate runs in Paris, London, and New York City. The 2025 Los Angeles shows saw the band stretching out and improvising deeply, drawing from their entire catalog and collaborating with new musicians, a creative approach they are excited to explore further this year.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?
