description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition? description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request.

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

This immersive playground offers 80 interactive exhibits designed to challenge your mind. See your friends shrink before your eyes, wander through endless corridors, and feel sensations that question your very perception of reality. Step into a world where reality comes with a twist. Grab your tickets now for Twist Museum in London!

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

description:
Direct from the Egyptian Museum Cairo. Ramses and the Pharaohs’ Gold brings 180 priceless treasures to London for the first and only time, in an exhibition that explores the extraordinary life, power and legacy of Egypt’s greatest pharaoh.

Transporting you from the temples of Abu Simbel to the Valley of the Kings, the exhibition’s crowning masterpiece is the Coffin of Ramses II — a once-in-a-generation opportunity to see the pharaoh’s original sarcophagus. Discover gold masks and silver coffins from the royal tombs of Tanis, beautifully preserved animal mummies and amulets, dazzling jewellery alongside colossal sculptures, carvings and stone heads.

Following acclaimed, sold-out runs in Tokyo, Paris, San Francisco and Sydney, Ramses and The Pharaohs’ Gold: The Exhibition runs in London at NEON, Battersea Power Station from 28 February 2026.

ABOUT RAMSES
Builder, Warrior, God…King Ramses II, widely known as Ramses the Great, ruled Egypt for nearly 67 years and remains history’s most iconic pharaoh.
Known for his extensive monument-building, military strategy and diplomacy, and a vast dynasty of more than 100 children, he also negotiated the world’s first recorded peace treaty after the Battle of Kadesh.  So powerful was his reign, that the nine pharaohs who followed him all adopted the name of Ramses to emulate his strength and vision.
This exhibition invites you to witness the rise of a ruler who sought not only to command an empire, but to secure his immortality for millennia to come.
Enhance your visit with optional add-ons, including an immersive VR journey and a multimedia audio guide narrated by leading historian and broadcaster Dan Snow, providing expert commentary and deeper historical context throughout the exhibition.
ACCESSIBILITY

Seating
Seating is available throughout the exhibition. During the introductory film, if you require a seat please let a member of staff know on arrival. Wheelchairs
the venue is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, you can reserve one by emailing londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com, or requesting it upon arrival at the Box Office.
Carer ticketsA free carer ticket is available for guests with access needs. Contact ouir box office  Londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com to request a companion ticket. 
Assistance DogsGuide dogs, hearing dogs, and officially registered assistance dogs are warmly welcome. Staff can provide a bowl of water upon request.
Lift Access
Our passenger lift provides step-free access to the first floor, where the exhibition is located (Max capacity: 13 people).
Parking
Paid parking is available near the venue at Battersea Power Station. Free parking for Blue Badge holders is available.
Information for deaf visitors
Full transcripts, large-print guides, and devices that stream directly to hearing aids are available. The multi-media guide is downloadable on your smartphone and adapts for accessibility needs. ToiletsAn accessible toilet with baby changing facilities ais available on the ground floor.

FAQS
Does the experience take place in an indoor or outdoor venue? The entire exhibition is indoors; however you may have to wait outside for a short time prior to entering the exhibition. 

How long does the experience last? About 60 minutes. 

Will food and beverage be available on site for purchase? Yes — there is a cafe within the venue after the exhibition. 

Is there parking available? Yes — there is public parking available within the Battersea Power Station estate a short walk away from the venue; however, there is no dedicated parking for the exhibition. 
 
Will there be merchandise for sale? Yes — there is a retail store within the exhibition space where items can be purchased. 
Do I need to print my ticket? No — your ticket and QR code are stored in your Universe account and sent in your purchase confirmation email. 

I can’t find my ticket. What should I do? You can view your ticket in the My Tickets section of your Universe account. If you don’t have an account, go to www.universe.com and log in with the same account you used to make the purchase. If you still can’t find it, contact londonboxoffice@neonglobal.com

Can I change the date of my ticket? Subject to availability, changes of date/time are permitted up to 48 hours before the start time. You can do this in your Universe account

What is your refund policy? Tickets are generally non-refundable. However, under special circumstances you can contact Universe with your order number and they may process a request. 

Can I transfer my tickets to another person? Yes — tickets can be transferred for free via your Universe account. 
Do I need to arrive at the start of my scheduled session? Please plan to arrive allowing time for travel, parking, and entry. It’s recommended to arrive 5–10 minutes before your scheduled time so ticket scanning can begin promptly. Tickets bought on-site are subject to availability, so online booking is strongly encouraged. 

Will there be strobe lights? Yes — during the presentation in the theatre room.

Can I take photos or record the experience? Yes — photography and filming are permitted during the experience. Flash photography is not permitted. 

Is there a Lost & Found? Staff at the venue can assist if you’ve lost belongings. 

Is a coat check available? There’s no cloakroom, Any bags larger than A4 will not be permitted inside the venue.

Are there any restrictions on what I can take in to the exhibition?  Eternal food and drink (excluding bottled water), alcohol, recreational drugs, any item(s) that could be considered a weapon (e.g. sharps), any item(s) that could be considered a fire hazard (e.g. lithium batteries), any item(s) that could be considered a protest material (e.g. marker pens, aerosols, flyers, stickers) and pets (unless it’s a service animal).

Is there an age requirement? The exhibition is recommended for ages 5+. Pushchairs can be held but are not allowed inside the galleries.

Will there be an audio guide? Yes — audio guides are available for purchase as an add-on; check the ticketing page to add one.

Grab your tickets now for Twist Museum in London!

description:
Doors 6.30pm |  7pm Cocktail Masterclass begins | Event Calendar CLICK HERE 

Looking to meet new people, make meaningful connections, and enjoy exceptional cocktails? Strangers in the city, Soul Mama and Windrush 1027 Rum have teamed up to bring you an unforgettable evening of conversation, creativity, and community.

Join us for Cocktail Making with Strangers, a unique social experience designed to bring together like-minded people in one of London's most vibrant venues. Whether you're new to the city, looking to expand your circle, or simply up for a great night out, this is the perfect opportunity to connect with others in a relaxed and welcoming setting.

Guided by expert hosts, you'll learn how to craft delicious cocktails using the award-worthy flavours of Windrush 1027 Rum, while enjoying engaging conversations, fun ice-breakers, and plenty of opportunities to meet new faces.

Expect:
• A hands-on cocktail-making experience
• Delicious Windrush 1027 Rum cocktails
• Strangers In The City goodie bag
• Prizes to be won 
• Great playlists to create an incredible atmosphere
• Genuine connections and unforgettable conversations
• A fun, relaxed evening with fellow city explorers

Come as strangers. Leave as friends.

Important Information:
By purchasing a ticket to a Strangers In The City event, you consent to photography and videography that may be used for future promotional purposes. Images will not be identified using full names without the subject's specific permission.

No refunds. Tickets are transferable only.

The Soul Mama Menu offers a delightful blend of African, Caribbean, and South American cuisine. Soul Mama was listed in the “top restaurants to look forward to in 2024 list” by the Evening Standard. Please take a moment to explore our menu.

description:
Beder invites you to a special evening dedicated to raising funds for mental health. 

Headlining the night is Harry Mack, the world-renowned freestyle artist whose extraordinary ability to transform audience energy into unforgettable, one-of-a-kind performances has captivated millions around the globe.

Beder is a charity committed to raising awareness around mental health and suicide prevention, with all proceeds supporting Beder Therapy Vouchers, providing free access to therapy for those in need. This is more than a concert — it’s an unforgettable evening of music, connection, and purpose, all in support of Beder.

Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. 

CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. This event is strictly 18+ with ID required on arrival at the venue.

description:
Old Rope is the legendary new material night, which has a monthly residency at The Comedy Store!

Hosted by Tiff Stevenson and featuring cameos from some amazing comedians and a host of familiar faces. Recent guests have included:

Stephen Merchant, Roisin Conaty, Brett Goldstein, Jamali Maddix, Sindhu Vee, Felicity Ward, Rich Hall, Michael Odewale, Aisling Bea, Rosebud Baker, Red Richardson, Katherine Ryan, Jack Dee, Darren Harriot, Nigel Ng, Alan Davies, Nish Kumar, Jena Friedman, Andy Zaltzman, Lou Sanders, Ria Lina, Munya Chawawa, Rob Delaney, Thanyia Moore, Josh Widdicombe, Alison Spittle, Mark Simmons, Milton Jones, Athena Kugblenu, Jack Dee, Luke McQueen, Fin Taylor, Eshaan Akbar, Sara Pascoe.

Our Rope alumni also includes: Ricky Gervais, Hannibal Buress, Michelle Wolf, Jarrod Carmichael, Noel Fielding, Amy Schumer, James Acaster, Daniel Kitson.

Come along, you never know who might turn up!

Strictly 18’s and over

description:
Five Women. One Sound. No apologies. A concert-theatre experience for everyone who has ever needed a night that was entirely, unapologetically theirs.

Sirens: The Concert Series is a high-voltage live concert experience featuring five fearless women and twenty of the most iconic songs ever written, from artists including Evanescence, Destiny's Child, Guns N' Roses, Kelly Clarkson, Dua Lipa, Alanis Morissette, Carrie Underwood, Bruno Mars, Lady Gaga, Billie Eilish, Michael Jackson, Christina Aguilera, Pussycat Dolls, Queen, Madonna and Sia.

Launching at Emerald Theatre London on 1st July 2026, each song is brought to life through the lens of a character you will recognise, a story you will feel, and a moment you will carry home.

description:
In the fall of 2025, DARKSIDE held a six-show residency at Lodge Room in Los Angeles. The trio of Dave Harrington, Nicolas Jaar and Tlacael Esparza had so much fun that they decided to do it all over again and then some. The band will now bring this same residency format to three new cities as part of their 2026 touring schedule, with a return to Lodge Room (eight shows across four nights this time), plus similar intimate runs in Paris, London, and New York City. The 2025 Los Angeles shows saw the band stretching out and improvising deeply, drawing from their entire catalog and collaborating with new musicians, a creative approach they are excited to explore further this year.

Grab your tickets now for Twist Museum in London!
